# Benefits

## Requirements

- Claims for sick pay must be paid within five working days of approval, per the Employment Agreement.

## Stories

- As an employee, I want sick pay to arrive within five working days of my claim being approved so that I can cover my bills.
- As a manager, I want to see who is absent today so that I can cover shifts.
- As an employee, I want to submit a sick note so that my absence is recorded.
